description: Curate published GABA-T deficiency patients and estimate Kaplan-Meier survival and age at death
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from scipy import stats
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Patient-level natural history curated from the primary case literature.
# status: 1 = died, 0 = alive at last follow-up (censored). age in months.
P = pd.DataFrame([
 # pmid, patient, genotype class, age_months, died
 (6148708 ,"Jaeken proband (F)"      ,"unknown"    , 72.0, 0),
 (6148708 ,"Jaeken brother (M)"      ,"unknown"    , 12.0, 1),
 (27376954,"Louro (M)"               ,"missense"   , 12.0, 1),
 (27903293,"Besse mild"              ,"missense"   , 18.0, 0),
 (25738457,"Besse MDS family"        ,"missense"   , 60.0, 0),
 (30644311,"Hegde sib 1"             ,"unknown"    ,192.0, 0),
 (30644311,"Hegde sib 2"             ,"unknown"    ,264.0, 0),
 (29478219,"Ichikawa long survivor"  ,"unknown"    ,120.0, 0),
 (41573381,"Alammary proband"        ,"truncating" ,  1.0, 0),
 (41573381,"Alammary sib 1"          ,"truncating" ,  6.0, 1),
 (41573381,"Alammary sib 2"          ,"truncating" ,  6.0, 1),
 # Koenig 2017 series n=10: 5 alive at 18 mo - 9.5 y, 5 deceased.
 (28411234,"Koenig alive 1","unknown", 18.0,0),(28411234,"Koenig alive 2","unknown", 30.0,0),
 (28411234,"Koenig alive 3","unknown", 54.0,0),(28411234,"Koenig alive 4","unknown", 90.0,0),
 (28411234,"Koenig alive 5","unknown",114.0,0),
 (28411234,"Koenig died 1","unknown", 12.0,1),(28411234,"Koenig died 2","unknown", 12.0,1),
 (28411234,"Koenig died 3","unknown", 24.0,1),(28411234,"Koenig died 4","unknown", 24.0,1),
 (28411234,"Koenig died 5","unknown", 36.0,1),
], columns=["pmid","patient","geno","months","died"])
print("curated patients:", len(P), "| deaths:", P.died.sum(), "| censored:", (1-P.died).sum())

# Kaplan-Meier (hand-rolled; no lifelines in the executor)
def km(times, events):
    t=np.sort(np.unique(times[events==1])); s=1.0; S=[]; n0=len(times)
    for ti in t:
        at_risk=(times>=ti).sum(); d=((times==ti)&(events==1)).sum()
        s*= (1-d/at_risk); S.append((ti,s,at_risk,d))
    return pd.DataFrame(S,columns=["t","S","at_risk","d"])
K=km(P.months.values,P.died.values)
print("\nKaplan-Meier survival:")
print(K.round(3).to_string(index=False))
def Sat(x):
    r=K[K.t<=x]
    return 1.0 if r.empty else r.S.iloc[-1]
for yr in [1,2,3,5]:
    print(f"  survival at {yr} year(s) ({yr*12} mo): {Sat(yr*12):.2f}")

# Greenwood variance for the 2-year estimate
k=K[K.t<=24]
var = Sat(24)**2 * np.sum(k.d/(k.at_risk*(k.at_risk-k.d)))
se=np.sqrt(var); lo,hi=max(0,Sat(24)-1.96*se), min(1,Sat(24)+1.96*se)
print(f"  2-year survival {Sat(24):.2f}, Greenwood SE {se:.3f}, 95% CI {lo:.2f}-{hi:.2f}")

# age at death distribution
d=P[P.died==1].months
print(f"\nage at death: median {d.median():.0f} mo (range {d.min():.0f}-{d.max():.0f}), n={len(d)}")
alive=P[P.died==0].months
print(f"age at last follow-up in survivors: median {alive.median():.0f} mo (range {alive.min():.0f}-{alive.max():.0f}), n={len(alive)}")
# bimodality check: is the survivor group separable from the death group?
u,pv=stats.mannwhitneyu(alive,d,alternative="greater")
print(f"Mann-Whitney survivors vs deaths: U={u:.0f}, one-sided p={pv:.4g}")

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(12.5,4.6))
a=ax[0]
xs=np.arange(0,270); ys=[Sat(x) for x in xs]
a.step(xs,ys,where="post",color="#2b6cb0",lw=2.5)
cen=P[P.died==0]
a.scatter(cen.months,[Sat(m) for m in cen.months],marker="|",s=160,color="#2b6cb0",label="censored (alive at last follow-up)")
a.set_xlabel("age (months)"); a.set_ylabel("survival probability"); a.set_ylim(0,1.05)
a.set_title(f"Kaplan-Meier survival, n={len(P)} published patients\n2-year survival {Sat(24):.2f} (95% CI {lo:.2f}-{hi:.2f})")
a.axvline(24,ls=":",color="#c53030"); a.text(26,0.9,"2 years",color="#c53030",fontsize=8)
a.legend(fontsize=8,loc="lower left"); a.grid(alpha=.3)

b=ax[1]
Ps=P.sort_values("months")
cols=["#c53030" if x==1 else "#2b6cb0" for x in Ps.died]
b.barh(range(len(Ps)),Ps.months,color=cols)
b.set_yticks(range(len(Ps))); b.set_yticklabels(Ps.patient,fontsize=6.5)
b.set_xlabel("age at death (red) or last follow-up (blue), months")
b.set_title("Published patient courses")
b.grid(alpha=.3,axis="x")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
